testSuite: DOC-58B Lifecycle State Machine Remediation Comparative Suite

scenarios.name: Failed Remove - Actor Confirmed Alive
scenarios.injectedFault: removeVisualActor returns DefiniteFailure (actor still in KEX sector list)
scenarios.expectedState: Baseline: LEAK to ABSENT / Candidate: QUARANTINED
scenarios.notes: Candidate retains pointer in QUARANTINED state, preventing orphan leak.

scenarios.name: Failed Remove - Result Uncertain
scenarios.notes: Ambiguous removal outcome correctly placed in quarantine.

scenarios.name: Successful Native Remove
scenarios.notes: Both cleanly retire on confirmed success.

scenarios.name: Repeated Remove After Failure
scenarios.injectedFault: Second executePendingRemove invoked on failed actor
scenarios.expectedState: Candidate blocks repeated seam call; Baseline calls with null or fails
scenarios.notes: Quarantine prevents blind native remove loops.

scenarios.name: Shutdown During SPAWN_PENDING
scenarios.notes: Spawn cleanly aborted without invoking native object factory.

scenarios.name: Shutdown During REMOVE_PENDING (Level Valid)
scenarios.injectedFault: Shutdown cleanup executed while level is valid
scenarios.notes: Standard shutdown cleanup when level structures are intact.

scenarios.name: Shutdown After Level Unloaded (UAF Hazard)
scenarios.injectedFault: KEX level unloaded before shutdown (isLevelValid = false)
scenarios.expectedState: Baseline: Calls remove on freed sectors (UAF) / Candidate: Skips native call
scenarios.notes: Prevents KEX Drain Use-After-Free during kexSlaveLevelLocal::Unload.

scenarios.name: Wrong Simulation Thread Affinity
scenarios.injectedFault: Method invoked from secondary worker thread
scenarios.expectedState: Baseline: Throws runtime_error (CRASH) / Candidate: Returns AffinityViolation
scenarios.notes: Baseline throws std::runtime_error which crashes unhandled C hooks in KEX.

scenarios.name: Exception from Mock Native Seam
scenarios.injectedFault: Native seam throws exception during remove
scenarios.expectedState: Baseline: Uncaught exception / Candidate: Caught and quarantined
scenarios.notes: Rogue seam exception caught inside candidate and placed in quarantine.

scenarios.name: Recycled Actor Pointer Tracking
scenarios.injectedFault: Allocator returns identical pointer address for new actor
scenarios.expectedState: Local generation incremented; distinct lifetime identity
scenarios.notes: Generational counter strictly monotonically increases across allocations.

scenarios.name: Stale DTO After Disconnect
scenarios.injectedFault: Late snapshot received from network queue after disconnect
scenarios.notes: Disconnected state machine strictly discards trailing wire packets.

scenarios.name: Map Epoch Invalidation
scenarios.injectedFault: Snapshot received with mismatched mapEpoch (9999 vs 7365)
scenarios.notes: Epoch mismatch rejected by snapshot Guard contract.

scenarios.name: Wrong Slot Protection (Client Puppet Slot 1)
scenarios.injectedFault: Incoming snapshot targeted at slot 1 instead of slot 0
scenarios.expectedState: Rejected with WrongSlot (never spawn visual proxy for local puppet)
scenarios.notes: Strict slot filtering protects local client puppet from proxy confusion.

scenarios.name: Unknown Sector Spawn Rejection
scenarios.injectedFault: Spawn requested with invalid sectorId (-1) or non-existent sector (999)
scenarios.expectedState: Baseline: Accepts without check / Candidate: Rejects with SectorValidationFailed
scenarios.notes: Unknown sector rejected; state machine stays pending without invoking factory.

scenarios.name: Mismatched Position/Sector (ADV-11 Fallacy)
scenarios.injectedFault: Coordinates are in Sector 176 (x=-7488, y=-7100), but spawn requested in 259
scenarios.expectedState: Baseline: Blind link to 259 (Phantom Sprite) / Candidate: Validation Rejected
scenarios.notes: Eliminates phantom invisibility and portal clipping crashes.

scenarios.name: Repeated Spawn After Quarantined Removal
scenarios.injectedFault: New snapshot arrives and spawn attempted while previous actor is quarantined
scenarios.expectedState: Baseline: Spawns duplicate actor (LEAK) / Candidate: Blocked by Quarantine
scenarios.notes: Quarantine strictly blocks spawning new proxy actors until engine cleanup.

scenarios.name: No Native Calls After Terminal Shutdown
scenarios.injectedFault: Repeated calls to handleSnapshot, spawn, remove after shutdown
scenarios.notes: Terminal state guarantees zero side-effects on native engine.

scenarios.name: No C++ Exceptions Across API Boundary (noexcept Audit)
scenarios.injectedFault: Adverse invocations across all public API methods
scenarios.notes: Eliminates all unhandled std::terminate crashes across KEX hook boundaries.
